facts.fact: The CAIDP's citizen guide says the right to request and obtain information held by public institutions is guaranteed by loi n°2013-867 of 23 December 2013; the page is undated, so the date is the law's.

The CAIDP's citizen guide describes the commission as taking referrals through its ACCESS WEB platform, mail or post when a public body refuses or does not answer, publishing its decisions on the access portal and in the official journal, and fining non-execution under article 20; the page is undated, so the published date is used.
facts.system: Commission d'Accès à l'Information d'intérêt public et aux Documents Publics (CAIDP)
